info.name: WePlay.cp-tracking-metricas.IntegrationTests
info.description:
Integration test collection for CP Tracking and Metrics API (US-CP-05)

Endpoints:
- POST /api/crowdpromotion/tracking/evento (public, no auth)
- POST /api/crowdpromotion/tracking/conversion (internal)
- GET /api/crowdpromotion/programas/{programaId}/metricas (artista auth)
- GET /api/crowdpromotion/promotor/metricas (promotor auth)

Dependencies:
- Auth module: user registration, login, JWT tokens
- cp-inscripcion-programa: programa, promotor, codigoReferido creation
- Crowdfunding: campania, backing for conversion tracking
